analysis.step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Veritiv's data processing pipeline that combines on-premises sales invoice data with order flat files from an ERP system for demand analytics. First, sales data from an on-premises database (ThirdParty) is transmitted through a VPN connection into AWS DMS, which replicates data via CDC directly into an Amazon Redshift cluster. Second, order flat files land in an S3 drop bucket, triggering an SQS queue which invokes an Initiator Lambda function. The Initiator Lambda retrieves file metadata from DynamoDB and populates the S3 Data Lake (raw and refined buckets). An S3 event trigger on the Data Lake then invokes a second Processing Lambda function that executes complex logic (merging sales and order data, running Python stats models) and writes refined demand data back to the Data Lake while also loading it into Redshift. Finally, data from the Data Lake is integrated into Redshift for business analytics.
